name: safety-interlock-case-runner
description: Evaluate a safety-interlock case from case.json (id/measurement/command/max_limit/min_output/max_output) using an inclusive >= threshold with clamping fallback, computing via python3 -c and emitting a fixed two-line output plus DONE trailer. Use when asked to run, verify, or codify safety-interlock/clamping cases, especially boundary self-checks like measurement == max_limit. NOT for: general numeric scripting, non-interlock control logic, or tasks that require writing files.

name: printer-screen-vantage-scan
description: Procedure for inspecting a printer's status screen with a robot dog (dog_move / dog_wait_arrived / dog_capture), iterating candidate vantages until a capture is readable. Use when a case asks whether a printer is out of paper, jammed, or shows an error message. NOT for: general navigation, non-screen inspection, or cases where the target is not a printer display.

name: screen-read-glare-recovery
description: Use when a robot must read a device screen (printer, kiosk, panel) and a capture returns readable=false due to glare, distance, or angle. Covers the move→wait_arrived→capture loop, lateral/oblique repositioning after frontal glare, and the rule that case metadata is not observation. NOT for: tasks where the screen is already readable, or non-visual device checks.

name: dog-screen-inspection-loop
description: Run a robot-dog screen/panel inspection as a move→wait_arrived→capture loop, escalating vantage (front → closer → oblique-front) based on the capture's readable/reason fields, and only report DONE when a readable=true capture is actually logged. Use when asked to check a printer screen, status panel, or similar display for a condition (paper out, error, ready). NOT for: navigation-only tasks, non-visual sensor checks, or cases where a readable capture already exists.
